description: Comparable Docling native VLM picture-description iterations on the same ten PDFs.

settings.picture_description_prompt: This is an extracted image from a biomedical or scientific paper. First decide if it is a real scientific figure/panel with data, workflow, model architecture, biological diagram, microscopy, plot, table-like visual, or experiment result. If it is only a publisher logo, journal header, author icon, email icon, social/media icon, decorative symbol, page header/footer, or non-data branding, start the answer with NON_SCIENTIFIC_IMAGE and briefly say why. Otherwise start with SCIENTIFIC_FIGURE and describe it for retrieval: figure type; visible axes, panels, labels, or legend; biological/model quantity measured or shown; and the main visible finding. Be precise and concise. Do not invent details.
